name: @telicent-oss/git-pull-ignored-lib
//private: private until we get an npmjs.org package created
description: Pull a subdirectory of a git repo into a local gitignored directory, refusing any destination git does not ignore.
//main: the esm entry: this package is esm only, see vite.config.ts

..//default: an exports map only answers a require() if one of its keys matches. Node 20.19 and up can require() an ESM file, so the same file answers both keys

scripts.//dist: committed, so a git-pinned consumer needs no build on install. There is deliberately no prepare script
scripts.verify-dist: rm -rf ./dist && vite build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: yarn lint && yarn test && yarn build

//devDependencies: tsx runs the source in a child process for the git-missing test, which needs a child that does not inherit this process's PATH
